Built Python and SQL ETL jobs for warehouse ingestion. Scheduled Airflow workflows and added data freshness checks and retry handling. Improved daily load reliability.
Designed Power BI dashboards and SQL reporting queries for inventory metrics. Documented metric definitions and reconciled report totals with finance exports.
Built FastAPI services for order processing. Added PostgreSQL migrations and idempotency keys. Maintained API integration tests and Docker development environments.
Created responsive React interfaces with TypeScript. Added keyboard navigation and tested user flows with Playwright. Maintained a shared component library.
Maintained Kubernetes deployments and CI pipelines. Configured Prometheus alerts and rehearsed recovery from service failures. Automated infrastructure changes with Terraform.
Tested web applications with Playwright and pytest. Investigated flaky tests and introduced focused smoke suites for release validation.
Trained image classifiers with PyTorch and evaluated augmentation strategies on labeled industrial images. Exported inference models and benchmarked latency.
Built demand forecasts in Python using time-series cross-validation. Compared seasonal baselines and gradient boosting. Published forecast error dashboards.
